mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_like_record (article_id, user_id, user_name, article_title, is_cancelled, create_time, cancel_time) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{articleTitle}, 0, NOW(), NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_cancelled = 0, cancel_time = NULL, user_name = #{userName}, article_title = #{articleTitle}
mapper.update: UPDATE article_like_record SET is_cancelled = 1, cancel_time = NOW() WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
UPDATE my_article SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND like_count > 0
